title: Penkenbahn Mayrhofen
highlights: Modern 3S gondola lift directly from Mayrhofen town center
Action mountain Penken with fun sports and via ferratas
Fantastic panoramic views across the entire Zillertal valley
Varied hiking trails and children play adventure areas
kurzbeschreibung: The modern Penkenbahn connects Mayrhofen with the action mountain Penken, a hotspot for hikers, mountain bikers, and climbing fans.
beschreibung:
Comfortably Ascending Action Mountain Penken

The state-of-the-art Penkenbahn swiftly and comfortably transports outdoor and sports enthusiasts from Mayrhofen up to the action mountain Penken. As a high-capacity 3S gondola lift, it overcomes considerable vertical metres while providing breathtaking views of the distinctive Zillertal mountain landscape throughout the ride.

Recreational Fun and Alpine Routes

Once at the top, visitors encounter a multifaceted paradise for outdoor athletes. From thrilling mountain bike trails and demanding via ferratas like the Knorren routes to family-friendly adventure paths around the Speicherteich Penken reservoir – on the Penken, every guest finds their ideal adventure against the imposing backdrop of the Zillertal.
